product_metadata.title: Yarlung 10 Inch Cast Iron Skillet with Glass Lid and Heat-Resistant Silicone Handle, Pre-Seasoned Frying Pan Safe Cooker for Oven, Induction, Grill, Stovetop, Pizza, Sauteing, Black
features: Our cast iron skillet is 10 inch in diameter, features double assist handles, attached with a heat-resistant silicone holder and a tempered glass lid. Master your dishes and enjoy handling easily when cooking and serving.
Iron deficiency is fairly common worldwide especially among women so cooking food in a cast iron skillet can increase iron content by as much as 20%.
A good seasoning makes all the difference. Yarlung skillet seasons with 100% vegetable oil, no synthetic coatings or chemicals. The more you use your iron, the better it performs.
Cast iron skillet is easy to clean and maintain. It should be hand washed with warm water, dried and restored with natural oils, that means no soap or dishwasher use.
Cast iron provides superior heat retention and is unparalleled for cooking, used to sear, sauté, bake, broil, braise, fry in the oven, stove, grill, induction cooktops or over a campfire.
